answer_1.quote: We propose TGMA, a topic-guided multi-agent framework for travel planning... The Intent Detection Agent transforms unstructured conversational dialogues into structured representations.
answer_1.outputs: travel plans with time arrangements, tickets, accommodations, and activity schedules

answer_2.quote: For dialogue capabilities... we employ standard dialogue quality metrics including BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L to assess the response generation.

answer_4.quote: We implement rigorous quality control... Our annotation team comprised 5 professionals... evaluating dialogues through multiple quality dimensions.
answer_4.guideline: Filter conversations with misaligned recommendations, redundant suggestions, or unnatural transitions; verify plan feasibility
